name: ironheights
description: Ironheights protects any AI bot that installs it: local security scanner for agent skills (OpenClaw, Claude, Grok Bot, Codex, Cursor, MCP), threat-model PR checks, MCP server, drift guard and posture report.

scripts.docs:rules: tsup scripts/generate-rules-doc.ts --no-config --format esm --target node20 --out-dir dist-scripts --clean --silent && node dist-scripts/generate-rules-doc.js
scripts.data:rules-json: tsup scripts/generate-rules-json.ts --no-config --format esm --target node20 --out-dir dist-scripts --clean --silent && node dist-scripts/generate-rules-json.js
scripts.docs:threatmodel-schema: tsup scripts/generate-threatmodel-schema.ts --no-config --format esm --target node20 --out-dir dist-scripts --clean --silent && node dist-scripts/generate-threatmodel-schema.js
